invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object created by bulkInsert, so it is unlikely to return null unless an exception is thrown.
getWriteStatuses() should return a non-null List of WriteStatus objects representing the bulk insertion outcome.
A List's size is always non-negative; write statuses will either be empty or contain WriteStatus elements.
Partition-to-write-stats mapping is recorded and expected to be non-null if write metadata is produced.
Commit metadata is typically present if and only if the write is committed.
